Overview

Takasaki is a city in with a population of 375,000. A historic transport hub in Gunma with a famous Daruma doll tradition and affordable cost of living. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
